rationale: Both work in consumer AI with complementary skill sets: Symphony Creative Studio brings product and marketing expertise in generative video tooling for creators and advertisers at scale, while Saurabh is a hands-on AI engineer building developer tools and agentic systems. intro_message: Symphony Creative Studio, meet Saurabh Khire — you're both in the consumer AI space and could pair well on a generative video or creator tooling hack where product-market thinking meets solid Python/backend engineering.
